essence: This deity embodies primordial nature, blissful wisdom, and cosmic enchantment.
This deity is universally desirable, boundless, and sovereignly benevolent toward all beings.
This deity transcends conditions while encompassing paradoxical aspects and universal governance.
This deity unites the roles of conscious witness, master of nature, and cosmic sustainer.
These attributes identify the deity with the classical iconography and lordship of Viṣṇu.
